subject: Acceptance vignettes, exit checkpoints, and decision canvas for evaluation
messages:
From: Marta Lopez <marta.lopez@avacarehealth.com>

Cc: 
Date: Wed, 21 Jul 2026 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: Eval acceptance criteria — quick alignment

Ben —

Thanks for the demo yesterday. The execs liked the latency/cost tradeoff we saw, but they want a short, concrete acceptance plan before signing off a pilot. Specifically they asked:

- What are the explicit pass/fail tests for the 4 core workflows (summarization, triage routing, note-gen, and embeddings search)?
- Which metrics count (latency P95, token cost per call, recall at K for embeddings)?
- What are the exit gates (hard stop vs. soft mitigation) if quality regresses during the trial?

Can you send a one-page mutual action plan + a compact set of acceptance vignettes we can share with engineering and procurement? We need this for our security & procurement review early next week.

Marta
Director, Clinical Ops
AvaCare Health

--

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>

Date: Thu, 22 Jul 2026 09:07:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Eval acceptance criteria — quick alignment

Marta —

Thanks for the clear ask. Attached is a compact MAP (AvaCare_MAP_v1.xlsx) and a short doc that lists 8 acceptance vignettes and the pass/fail rules (acceptance-vignettes.md). High-level answers below:

Summary (TL;DR)
- Primary metrics: latency P95 (target < 300ms for triage and < 600ms for summarization), token cost per call (target <$0.02 avg), and recall@10 for embeddings (target >= 0.85 on internal test set).
- Acceptance tests: 8 vignettes covering clinical note summarization accuracy (F1-like check), routing precision/recall for triage, hallucination rate threshold for note-gen, embedding relevance recall. Each vignette has a clear pass threshold and sample test artifacts.
- Exit gates: Hard stop if any safety/regression > SLA (e.g., hallucination spike > 5% on clinical vignettes) or security finding that cannot be mitigated in 72 hours. Soft mitigation: auto-fallback to smaller model variant + daily remediation plan.

Next steps I propose:
1) You review the two attachments with clinical/engineering stakeholders.
2) We run a 2-week smoke window (sandbox) using your redacted data slice; run the 8 vignettes.
3) If pass, move to a 4-week pilot under the committed capacity. If fail, run targeted remediation playbook and re-test.

Attachment: AvaCare_MAP_v1.xlsx (mutual action plan, milestones, owners)
Attachment: acceptance-vignettes.md (detailed vignettes, test vectors)

I can join your procurement call on Monday if helpful.

Best,
Ben
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
Phone: +1 415 555 0123

--

Note: the attachments include a simple decision canvas sheet (columns: Milestone, Owner, Evidence, Pass Criteria, Fail Action).

Thanks — this is close to what we need. A few clarifications from our side before I circulate:

2) For embeddings: can we include a recall@5 target as well? Many of our queries are short and users care about top 5.
3) On security: procurement asked for an explicit remediation SLA for PII leakage tests (we need a ≤48hr acknowledgement and a 7-day fix plan).

If you can update the MAP with those specifics and include a single example test vector for each vignette, we'll be good to share with procurement.

Marta

Ben —

Attached is a short scoring recipe outline for clinical summarization and two example gold labels (CSV). Key points:

- Annotator guidance: mark span-level clinical facts (Dx, meds, plan) and a sentence-level importance score (0-2). Score computed as weighted overlap between predicted summary and gold spans (we propose weighted-F1 with weights: Dx=3, Meds=2, Plan=1).
- Tolerance window: ignore formatting and stopwords; normalize numeric variations.
- Example gold labels: sample_1.csv, sample_2.csv

I also added a sample scoring script link in the MAP (python snippet + pseudo-code). Feel free to reword before sending to AvaCare.

Marissa
Sr Manager, Solutions Engineering | Redwood Inference

Attachment: summarization-scoring-recipe.zip (contains sample CSVs and scoring-snippet.py)

Marta —

Thanks again — attaching the updated MAP and the acceptance vignettes that incorporate Marissa's scoring recipe and Grace's SLA language. Highlights:

- Summarization scoring: we propose weighted-F1 (Dx:3, Meds:2, Plan:1), example vectors included. Pass threshold: weighted-F1 >= 0.78 on the provided test set.
- Embeddings: added recall@5 >= 0.80 and recall@10 >= 0.88 (we kept recall@10 target from earlier).
- PII remediation SLA: acknowledgement within 48 hours, remediation plan within 7 calendar days, interim mitigations within 72 hours if needed; documented escalation path to our Security Lead.
- Exit gates: clarified hard stop conditions (security block, repeat hallucination > 5% across safety vignettes) and soft fallbacks.

Attachments: AvaCare_MAP_v1.xlsx, acceptance-vignettes.md, summarization-sample-csvs.zip

Next step: if this looks right, please confirm and we'll lock the MAP as the evaluation agreement. We can also add one quick joint runbook call to walk through the test vectors with your QA team.

Ben
